hook.name: Security scan on response/AI changes
hook.description: Run bandit whenever response engine or AI pipeline files are saved

steps.name: Check for LIVE_ACTIONS guard
steps.prompt: The file ${file} was saved. It is part of the response engine or AI pipeline. Check that: (1) any new action execution code path passes through ResponseGuard, (2) no subprocess/os.system calls use user-influenced arguments, (3) AI output is validated before storage. Report any violations found.
